questions.prompt:
Select the option which will best replace the words underlined in the sentence to make it correct.

Molly have two sisters.
questions.explanation: When someone else has something we use "has" instead of "have": "Molly has two sisters."

questions.prompt:
Select the option which will best replace the words underlined in the sentence to make it correct.

I likes cricket much I could play it every day.
questions.explanation: In the first person "like" has no "s", and to describe how strong a feeling is we say "so much" rather than just "much".

questions.prompt:
Select the option which will best replace the words underlined in the sentence to make it correct.

I have three cat and two dog.
questions.explanation: "Three" and "two" are more than one, so both "cat" and "dog" need an "s": "three cats and two dogs".

questions.prompt:
Select the option which will best replace the words underlined in the sentence to make it correct.

I shooted three goals in netball.
questions.explanation: The past tense of "shoot" is "shot".

questions.prompt:

I went in...

questions.explanation: The full sentence must keep the same meaning: "I went in an aeroplane to Sydney." Option C is wrong because "aeroplane" starts with a vowel sound and needs "an", not "a".

questions.prompt:

Some horses can run as fast as a car.

What does this sentence suggest?

options.label: A
options.text: Some horses run faster than cars.

options.label: C
options.text: It is just as quick to get around on a horse as in a car.
